verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs explicitly say admins can control which MCP servers developers can access from their IDEs and can use allow lists to block unauthorized access. They also describe managing agents and enforcing governance from a single control plane with audit logs, which covers the core of controlling the agent's external integrations. Missing for 10: per-tool or per-integration permission granularity beyond MCP servers (e.g., partner agent apps, cloud agent network or tool scopes), in-depth policy configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
